component.name: SpyServer
component.summary: Airspy SpyServer network sharing for onboard SDRs

description.p: Start and stop per-dongle Airspy SpyServer network shares for the RTL-SDR radios on an AryaOS device, and copy the spyserver:// client URL for use in SDR#, SDRangel or SDR++. The share server is unauthenticated and opt-in (the firewall does not open its port by default).
